subject: Control/Data Concordance: Ops review and deployment checklist
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: eng_ops@edgecloud.com, network@acme.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Oct 2028 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Control/Data concordance: can we lock on the operational contract?

Hi all,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. As we prep the private VPC deploy with EdgeCloud for ACME, I want to lock a few operational contracts between the control plane and data plane so we can finalize the runbook. High-level asks:

- Confirm control plane endpoints (FQDNs and expected source IP ranges) for management traffic.
- Decide on BGP peering vs static routes for tenant egress (ACME preference noted below).
- Agree where telemetry (metrics/traces) will egress — Redwood central telemetry or EdgeCloud collector?

I've attached an updated reference diagram (control-data-concordance-diagram-v2.pdf) and an action matrix with gaps I flagged. Please review and reply with any blockers.

Proposed next step: 30m ops readout on Tue Oct 17 to triage open items, finalize runbook.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

Attachments: control-data-concordance-diagram-v2.pdf (diagram), action-items-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: EdgeCloud Ops <eng_ops@edgecloud.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, network@acme.com
Date: Tue, 10 Oct 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Control/Data concordance: can we lock on the operational contract?

Hi Naomi — thanks for the diagram, looks clear. A couple quick notes from our side:

- We can expose a pair of regional control plane endpoints per tenant: cp-us-west.redwood-edge.io and cp-us-east.redwood-edge.io. Source IPs will be our managed NAT range 34.120.0.0/18 (proposal).
- For ACME, they asked for BGP as they have dynamic routing needs; we can support a peering session per tenant (BGP ASN range we advertise will be 65010–65020).
- Telemetry: by default we push to Redwood's collector via TLS; if ACME wants to keep telemetry private we can terminate at the EdgeCloud collector and mirror to Redwood via a tenant-controlled tunnel.

We'll review the action matrix and come back with suggested changes. Tue Oct 17 works for us for the readout.

— Sam (EdgeCloud)
Samir Patel, Senior Ops Engineer
eng_ops@edgecloud.com

Attachments: none

From: ACME Network <network@acme.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, eng_ops@edgecloud.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Oct 2028 08:20:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Control/Data concordance: can we lock on the operational contract?

Thanks Naomi and Sam. ACME prefers BGP for the long-lived peering (we have automation that relies on route updates). A couple of clarifications:

- We need a route advertisement policy doc so our infra team can set filters.
- For control-plane IP allowlist, can you provide a CIDR /27 per endpoint? Our security team requires tight ranges.
- Telemetry: ACME will mirror to EdgeCloud collector; please document retention and PII scrubbing steps.

We can join the readout on Oct 17 at 10:00 PT.

Regards,
Elaine Zhao
Network Engineering Manager, ACME Corp
network@acme.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: eng_ops@edgecloud.com, network@acme.com
Date: Fri, 13 Oct 2028 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Control/Data concordance: can we lock on the operational contract?

Folks — consolidating notes ahead of the readout. Please see inline items below: 

1) Control plane endpoints/CIDRs (ACME asked for /27s) — ACTION: EdgeCloud to confirm per-endpoint /27s; if not feasible provide smallest feasible CIDR. (owner: eng_ops)

2) BGP peering — ACTION: ACME to share their ASN and prefix filters; EdgeCloud to provide their ASN pool and sample export policy. (owners: network@acme.com, eng_ops)

3) Telemetry path & PII — DISCUSSION: default is Redwood collector; for ACME we will mirror at EdgeCloud and apply PII scrubbing. Need list of fields deemed PII. (owners: marissa_cole, acme)

4) Egress path for model-serving traffic — DECISION POINT: do we route tenant egress via EdgeCloud NAT (observability + DLP) or allow direct egress from customer subnets? Ops prefers NAT via EdgeCloud for auditability; ACME may want a direct path for performance-sensitive flows. Add perf test to alpha stage. (owner: jonas_weber)

5) Runbook acceptance criteria — ACTION: create a deploy checklist that includes BGP session up, control plane token rotation validated, telemetry sink verified, and a synthetic inference smoke test. (owner: naomi_feldman)

I uploaded a short checklist to the Drive link in related_links. Please review before Tue.

Naomi

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Cc: eng_ops@edgecloud.com, network@acme.com
Date: Tue, 17 Oct 2028 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Control/Data concordance: ops readout notes

Quick readout notes from today's 30m: 

- EdgeCloud confirmed they can provide per-endpoint /27s for the control plane endpoints in prod; they will use 34.120.4.0/27 and 34.120.4.32/27 for the two regional endpoints. (edge confirmed)
- ACME shared ASN 65123 and sample export filters; EdgeCloud will send their sample export policy by EOD Oct 18. (action: eng_ops)
- Telemetry: agreed to mirror at EdgeCloud, run PII scrubbing rules; Marissa to share the initial PII field list by Oct 19. (action: marissa_cole)
- Egress: performance test to be part of alpha; EdgeCloud to run latency/throughput microbenchmarks and share results. If latency penalty <4ms median, default to routed NAT path for observability. (action: jonas_weber + eng_ops)
- Runbook: Naomi will publish final checklist and acceptance criteria after telemetry PII list arrives.

I've attached the quick meeting notes and updated the action-items-matrix.xlsx in Drive.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Cc: eng_ops@edgecloud.com, network@acme.com
Date: Fri, 19 Oct 2028 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Control/Data concordance: final items and runbook publish

All — closing the loop. Per action items: 

- EdgeCloud has sent the sample BGP export/import policy and confirmed the /27 assignments (see attachment in their email thread).
- ACME confirmed ASN and will run through their filters next week.
- Marissa: PII field list uploaded to the Confluence page referenced in related_links.
- Jonas: perf microbenchmarks scheduled Oct 21; we'll use the results to pick default egress path in the runbook.

Next steps: Naomi to publish the runbook (final) by Oct 24. I'm marking the thread as 'ready for runbook publish' once Naomi confirms.

Thanks everyone — clean coordination.

Marissa Cole
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference
